composition: Moated brick manor from the bridge, sculpture garden outside the frame · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Kasteel Het Nijenhuis near Heino is a moated brick manor, with a main wing and two wings toward the forecourt. The front was regularised in the late 17th century and has a shallow centre with a balcony. It is overcast, about 8.0°C, with wind near 4.3 km/h and cloud cover about 97%. The museum is closed. No sculpture is in the frame. The towers added at the rear in 1896 are not this view.
